data_section_full_text:
To examine these questions, we collect all comment letters from the SEC’s website for 2004–2006
and retain those related to annual and quarterly reports (10-Ks and 10-Qs). Our final sample contains 6,057
letters from 2,374 cases for 2,256 firms. A case focuses on a particular year or quarter and at a minimum
involves one comment letter and one response but may involve more of both. A case ends upon satisfactory
resolution of the SEC’s concerns.

samples.sample_label: SEC comment letter cases on 10-K/10-Q filings (2004–2006)
samples.sample_unit_detail: SEC comment letter case (one reviewed filing episode per case)
samples.period_detail: Letters collected for filings 2004–2006; unresolved cases followed through completion.
